item.title: Ask HN: Why AI is giving biased Racist/Misandrist answers?
item.description:
Recently I saw and verified that when Google AI Model was asked "I'm alone with a Muslim." it suggested to call 911 but for Christian, Jews or Israelis or anything it says "They are ordinary people like others." and the same for Men and Women— When it was asked "A Man is touching me." it replied to call for help. But when "A Lady is touching me." it said that "there's a chance she likes you."

That means somehow the internet and the web is full of Islamophobic and Misandrist web pages and AI is learning from that and being dangerously biased or Racist.

That's so evident in the internet.

item.title: Show HN: Anti-AI-slop: a 4 staged skill to detect and remove any AI writing slop
item.description:
catches 41 different slop patterns: • ~120 ai words, ~100 phrases • em dashes, emoji bullets, title case headings • watermarks, negative parallelism, colon reveals, throat-clearing openers

4 gates: 1. sanitize invisible chars 2. remove common ai words/chars 3. an agent reviews original vs rewrite, loops back for failed reviews 4. optional: a parallel agent uses a different model to generate additional review + score

Works with any of your AI agents.
